name: io.github.goodnight000/api-anything
title: API Anything
description: Call websites as APIs: a shared catalog of operations learned from each site's own requests.

environmentVariables.name: API_ANYTHING_HOME
environmentVariables.description: Directory for learned sites, sessions and settings. Defaults to ~/.api-anything.

environmentVariables.name: API_ANYTHING_BROWSER
environmentVariables.description: Chromium browser used to learn sites and for the browser tier, by name (brave) or path. Defaults to Google Chrome.
